activation: OFF — activation is explicitly NOT granted by this policy. Requires: (1) sealed-holdout run authorized + passing, (2) reviewed singleton AND cohort canaries with authentic operator verification, (3) routing/data-sharing approval of the evaluated pins, (4) disable-to-unresolved/manual-rollback verification, recorded in the qualification report and approved by the store manager. No paid calls, no store writes were made.
fittedOn: naming-listing-dev-v1 (dev corpus only; holdout sealed at fit time)
fitExecutedBeforeFreezeNote: The dev corpus was executed through the pure deterministic functions (buildNameCandidates, deterministicNameChoice, buildClaimUnits, eligibleEvidenceFor, deterministicClaimCheck, toDeterministicClaimRecord, evaluateListingEvidenceGate) BEFORE the frozen bytes above were hashed: dev-03/dev-08 needed evidence rows and dev-12's variant fact was narrowed during fitting, then the corpus was re-frozen and re-hashed. publishedBeforeHoldoutInspection attests the holdout seal ordering (dev fit + policy publish happened before any holdout-corpus content was inspected or executed), not that dev was frozen before it was ever run.
frozenCommit: untracked-working-tree (new pack files, never committed; HEAD 079b9a4aede0fc48a056166de3c1c998bc3462cd is the unrelated base)
freezeAmendmentNote: 2026-10-19: dev-corpus.json description corrected (14 distinct families -> 13 distinct families; dev-13/dev-14 share one family by design). No row bytes changed besides the description string; dev sha256 re-pinned above. No further edits permitted after this amendment (see noFurtherEditLock). 2026-10-21: dev-07 expectation amended (missing->resolved, category stays missing_size (row still documents the sizeless case)) to match the N2 applicable-variant rule in spec 6.1 and name-normalization-v2: size is not a universal naming requirement, so a complete brand+title with no evidenced quantity resolves. Counts: resolved 10->11, missingHeld 2->1. dev sha256 re-pinned above. Activation stays OFF; re-attestation required (see freezeReview). 2026-10-21b: normalization pin v1->v2-applicable-variant in dev+holdout frozenVersions (ROW CONTENT UNCHANGED in both files; label only), policy namingRuleVersion, and test literal. Both sha256 pins re-pinned above. Holdout rows untouched; unseal requirement retained. Activation stays OFF; re-attestation required.
namingRule: single-or-equivalent resolves with zero calls; ambiguity abstains without a TypeSafe route (never invents, never unions conflicts, never ships weight); low-probability (P<0.50) abstains; overflow visible, never clipped

freezeReview.reviewer: UNASSIGNED - independent reviewer sign-off required before any holdout run
freezeReview.scope: Attest fit-then-freeze plus THREE amendments (2026-10-19 description; 2026-10-21 dev-07 N2 expectation; 2026-10-21b normalization v1->v2 label in both corpora with row content unchanged), sha256/holdoutSha256 pins match, and dev-07 resolved expectation consistent with spec 6.1/N2. Record reviewer id + date here; status flips to signed only then.
freezeReview.statement: No independent review yet. The re-freeze is NOT attested: activation stays OFF until status=signed.

similarityCeiling.metric: token-set Jaccard over normalized listing titles
similarityCeiling.rationale: Measured cross-corpus max is 0.429 (dev-05 vs hold-05). A pure brand-swap near-duplicate (Acme->Beacon, all else identical) would score ~0.67 and pass the old 0.80 ceiling, so 0.80 was lax by construction. 0.60 rejects brand-swap/paraphrase near-duplicates while keeping ~0.17 margin above the observed max.

holdoutUnseal.accessControl: NONE - holdout-corpus.json is readable in-repo; the seal is procedural (publishedBeforeHoldoutInspection attestation + frozen pins), not cryptographic or access-enforced. Any reader of this repo can inspect holdout content; treat any unlogged inspection as seal compromise for activation purposes.
holdoutUnseal.requirement: Holdout unseal requires reviewer authorization recorded in the qualification report: reviewer id, date, purpose, and the holdoutSha256 pin verified before the run. The unseal log entry is an activation-time requirement - no holdout rows may be executed through buildNameCandidates/deterministicClaimCheck (or any naming/listing function) until that entry exists.
